title: 1RB---_1RC0RD_1RD1RA_1LE1RB_0LF0LE_1RF0RD: halts if and only if an integer map reaches one pattern, in Lean
text: The whole run is proved for every size: the machine follows an explicit map phase on three numbers, and it halts from blank tape if and only if the orbit of that map meets (m, m + 2, 2m+1 + 1), the all-ones string (halts_iff_family). An invariant of the overflow phase shows the map never gets stuck anywhere else, and the family is proved to halt for every m. Iterated for 100,000 phases (about 10153,000 steps) the orbit never meets it.
